title: Bledsoe drawing cell diagrams for Taylor's team

tellings.quote: I'm a carpenter and yet I'm reading papers at night that they would send me and my job was to draw whatever came out of me, whatever I saw.

plain: Between 2008 and 2011 in North Carolina, a carpenter named Chris Bledsoe says he spent his nights reading scientific papers sent to him by a team linked to a man named Timothy Taylor, and his job was to draw cell diagrams, "whatever came out of me, whatever I saw." Bledsoe tells Michels this as something he did himself, and he also names Diana Pasulka in connection with it. If true, it would mean researchers were treating an untrained man's visions as a source of scientific insight.
